verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a git client with strong commit, diff, checkout and undo features, and it supports automation through Shortcuts and x-callback-url. But no evidence shows it versions, reviews or rolls back the automations themselves. Storing exported automation files in a repo would be a user-side workaround, and the Shortcuts app is a host-platform feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
